title: Cumulative, cross-turn session trace
description: F2: clozn.runs.session_trace.build_trace()'s output -- the ordered, paginated evidence trail for one session, composed ENTIRELY from already-persisted run data (clozn.runs.sessions.list_session_runs for ordering/pagination, clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs for turn-to-turn drift, clozn.runs.diagnosis_rules.evaluate for per-turn diagnostics). Never persisted as a stored blob -- like clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 and clozn.performance-trace.v1, it is recomputed fresh on every call; a registered schema is still warranted because the SHAPE is a contract the conversation investigation view (F3) relies on. 'Difference'/'Classification'/'Finding' below are deliberately LOOSE passthrough projections of clozn.run-diff.v1 and clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 respectively -- this schema does not re-govern shapes those artifacts' own schemas already own; it only asserts the two anchor fields this module's own code depends on, so it never needs a version bump when either sibling artifact adds a field. first_went_wrong_candidates is a set of DETERMINISTIC heuristic CANDIDATES (first turn with a diagnostic finding, first identity/generation-setting drift, first failed/cancelled run) -- never a causal claim; no entry anywhere in a real document produced by this schema's owning module states or implies that one candidate explains another turn's behavior.

ContextUsage.description: Every key omitted, never zero-padded, when context_receipt.limits did not record it for this turn.

Difference.description: A loose passthrough of one clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs() differences[] entry -- only 'dimension'/'kind' are asserted here; value_a/value_b/evidence/note are whatever run_diff itself produced, untyped by design (see this schema's top-level description).

Classification.description: A loose passthrough of one clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs() findings[] entry (its human-readable classification layer, e.g. 'model_changed', 'context_omission').

Finding.description: A loose passthrough of one clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1 findings[] entry with status=='finding' only -- see clozn.runs.diagnosis_rules for the full rule catalog and status vocabulary. Only the two fields this module's own code depends on are asserted.

StatusCounts.description: clozn.diagnosis-findings.v1's own five-value status tally for this turn -- always all five keys, since evaluate() always produces exactly one finding entry per rule in RULE_REGISTRY.

ContextChanges.description: What entered/left the delivered context since the previous turn -- new_segments/dropped_segments make context CARRIED FORWARD from earlier turns visibly distinct from genuinely NEW input on this turn (everything delivered this turn that is not in new_segments is, by construction, carried forward).

TurnComparison.description: Comparison of this turn against the immediately preceding LINEAR turn (never a branch), via clozn.analysis.run_diff.compare_runs -- never re-derived. Present on every turn except the session's first. available=false means compare_runs() itself could not compare the pair (e.g. a malformed run record); reason then names why, and settings_changes/context_changes/classifications are absent rather than fabricated as empty.

Branch.description: A run whose parent_run_id points at one of this page's linear turns -- surfaced separately, never flattened into `turns`.

Candidate.description: A deterministic, evidence-referencing CANDIDATE for where the session's evidence trail first shows a problem -- never labeled or implied as 'the cause'. See this schema's top-level description for the exact honesty constraint enforced (in code, not just convention) on every string this module emits.
